headline: The week held green as *Friday gave way*
subline: Nifty gained 0.36% on the week. Friday fell, yet smallcaps still rose.
hero_text: Nifty fell 1.07% on Friday but still ended the week up 0.36%. Smallcap 250 rose 0.53% while the frontline slid.

why.title: IT gave back part of its run
why.desc: Nifty IT fell as Infosys, HCLTech and TCS all lost ground.

why.title: Autos fell with Bajaj Auto
why.desc: Nifty Auto dropped as Bajaj Auto lost 3.36%.

why.title: A broad dip with no catalyst
why.desc: No single news item explained it. Forty of 50 Nifty names fell.

why.title: Wall Street rose, Nifty fell
why.desc: The S&P 500 gained while Indian indices slipped.

sector_reasons.IT: Led the week despite Friday's Infosys and TCS drag
sector_reasons.Realty: Held a weekly gain even as Friday slipped
sector_reasons.Media: Slid through the week, Friday's bounce was small
sector_reasons.Metal: Lost the week though JSW Steel and Hindalco rose Friday
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Slipped on the week as lenders stayed soft

bonus_text: IT led the week at 5.95% and realty added 3.88%. Media fell 6.23% and metal lost 3.43%.
movers_note_gainers: BEL led at 1.72%. JSW Steel and Hindalco made it two metal names.
movers_note_losers: Shriram Finance and Bajaj Auto led the losers.
watch_text: TechM's 1:1 bonus goes ex on Monday. Nifty option OI stacks at 25,000 puts and 27,000 calls.
lessons: Metal and media rose Friday but lost the week. IT did the reverse.
Smallcaps rose while 40 of 50 Nifty names fell. The drop sat in large caps.
Wall Street rose and the Nifty fell. Friday's drop did not follow global cues.
Autos, IT and lenders fell together. Bajaj Auto, HCLTech and Shriram Finance led the losers.
alert_text: Monday 30 November is the next session. TechM trades ex bonus 1:1 that day.
cta_headline: A green week, a red Friday. *Save it for Monday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Monday 30 November.
next_text: Monday 30 November opens the next week. The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday 1 December.
caption_a:
Nifty fell 1.07% on Friday to 25,607 but still gained 0.36% on the week.
Smallcap 250 rose 0.53% while Nifty IT fell 1.88%.
FIIs bought Rs 1,634.33 Cr in cash. DIIs trimmed Rs 556.42 Cr.
Watch: TechM trades ex bonus 1:1 on Monday.
